title: Rug Pull Alert
description: A rug puller flashes red and you hear a warning half a second before it lunges, so you can sidestep: rug pullers ended 37.5% of yesterday's runs.

title: Moon Rocket
description: A rare rocket drops from a kill: grab it and the bull rides it across the screen for 4 s, untouchable, ramming every bear in its path.

title: Ghost Run
description: On the Daily, a see-through ghost of your best run plays beside you, so you can see exactly where you're ahead or behind.
